name: attest
description: Prove what your AI agent actually did: decide, gate behind a human, verify by read-back, record a hash-chained ledger.
long_description:
Attest exposes six tools — attest_decide, attest_confirm, attest_confirm_status, attest_record, attest_verify, attest_ledger — so an agent can check policy before acting, ask a human, verify an action against the system of record with your own tokens, and keep a tamper-evident ledger locally.

Requires `uv` on the machine (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/): the bundle runs `uvx attestlayer`, which fetches the published package and keeps it current.

tools.name: attest_decide
tools.description: Evaluate an action against the Attest policy before doing it. Returns decision (act|ask|refuse), risk_tier, reasons, target_class.

tools.name: attest_confirm
tools.description: Ask a human to confirm an action (web inbox / Slack / webhook). With wait=true blocks until decided (timeout_s); otherwise returns a request id to poll with attest_confirm_status.

tools.name: attest_confirm_status
tools.description: Status of a confirm request (id or resume token).

tools.name: attest_record
tools.description: Record an action that already happened. Pass the tool's result for an acknowledged/attested-only level, or verified=true/false with evidence.

tools.name: attest_verify
tools.description: Read back an action from the system of record with the configured credentials and compare it with the intent. Returns level (verified|acknowledged|unverified|…) and evidence.

tools.name: attest_ledger
tools.description: Query the ledger: last N entries, filtered by run_id / level; verify the chain.

confirm_timeout.title: Confirmation timeout (seconds)
confirm_timeout.description: How long attest_confirm waits for a human
